company_name: WINIFRED INTERNATIONAL TECHNOLOGY LIMITED TAIWAN BRANCH
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Winifred International Technology Limited provides support products and services that are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in contamination control and cleanroom supplies.
summary: Winifred International Technology Limited specializes in micro-contamination control solutions for modern manufacturing technologies, offering a range of products and services including cleanroom supplies and equipment calibration. They have established a strong logistical network in China to support just-in-time delivery and inventory management for their clients in the electronics and pharmaceutical sectors.

regional_presence.China: Winifred has a significant presence in China with 4 warehouse hubs and 19 service centers across major cities.
